title: Local web project chat
responsibility: Hosts the shared project conversation in the web explorer and connects its backend when the bubble opens.

inputs.name: ConsoleChat.base
inputs.description: Required string prefix supplied by the host. It is concatenated directly with the path before the first ? when the component is mounted and open; no separator is inserted.

inputs.name: ConsoleChat.path
inputs.description: Required path string supplied by the host. When the component is mounted and open, text from the first ? onward is removed before concatenation with base; the value is not otherwise transformed here.

inputs.name: ConsoleChat.navigate
inputs.description: Required host router callback passed to createConsoleWorkspaceStore; it accepts a string and a boolean and returns void. When mounted and open, the component asks the workspace to navigate with replace set to false.

outputs.name: ConsoleChat
outputs.description: Svelte markup for an hx-div.console-chat wrapper containing ProjectAgent, with open bound to the component state and workspace set to the created store workspace. The workspace route is updated only when the component is mounted and open.
